draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.32, the 51st-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 7th of 31 at WR. He lasted until pick 133, well after his grade rank (51st): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing standouts: 10-yard split (88th percentile). College production: 834 receiving yards in 2024, 16th of 31 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Kansas City Chiefs. 7 career games and 2 starts over 1 completed season, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 0 AV in 2025. Weak spots: team target share 0.5% (5th percentile), approximate value 0 (5th percentile). Played 7 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-1 wide receiver who played: 4 receiving yards against a median of 198, below the norm.
